title: Made with Purpose
story:
A carpenter carefully worked on a piece of wood.

He measured it.

He carved it.

He sanded every rough edge.

A young boy watching nearby asked,

“Why are you spending so much time on just one piece?”

The carpenter smiled.

“Because this isn't just a piece of wood.

It's going to become a beautiful chair that someone will use every day.”

When the chair was finished, it was both beautiful and useful.

Every cut and every detail had a purpose.

In the same way, God is the Master Craftsman.

He created each one of us with care.

We are not accidents.

We are His workmanship.

He has prepared good works for us to do.

As we follow Him, our lives become a blessing to others and bring glory to Him.
life_lesson: You are God's masterpiece, created with purpose. He has prepared good works for you to accomplish.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for creating me with love and purpose.

Help me to see myself as Your workmanship.

Show me the good works You have prepared for me.

May my life reflect Your wisdom and bring glory to Your name.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you believe your life has a purpose designed by God?

What gifts has He given you to serve others?

What is one good work you can do today for His glory?
verse: For we are God's workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.
